text_block_list.name: Cheerful Sound
text_block_list.text:
(—*Tsukuten-tsukuten, tsukuten-ten*♪ 
—*Tsukuten-tsukuten, tsukuten-ten*♪)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—Yu~~~koma, what a wonderful place...♪ 
—The water is so nice and warm...♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Haaah~~ Yum yum!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—Yu~~~koma Hot Springs~~...♪ Pyoiya! 
Soi-soi!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Royce and Royce here! Today, I'm 
visiting the Yukoma Hot Springs District~♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I got so excited that I ended up 
singing the "Bath-Stepping Song"♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Excavation? No, it's to recover 
from fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You'll wash away your fatigue from the 
Aoba Sho at the hot springs, right?
choice_data_list:
It helps with fatigue recovery and helps 
you relax, too.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The Nippon Derby is coming up fast... so 
I'm completely resetting my stance.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...The royal road from the Satsuki Sho to 
the Derby was impossible for me back then, 
since my body wasn't strong enough..."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
This choice is just as tough, but... If 
there's even the slightest bit more 
hope...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I've decided to do everything within my 
power and take on this rotation!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Stake everything on the Japan Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Repeating those words to myself over and 
over, I've kept running all the way 
here...!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I will seize victory, without fail...! 
Please watch over me!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"She's literally putting everything on the 
line to take on this challenge...! She did 
so much just to make this race rotation 
work."

text_block_list.name: Royce's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"If we've come this far with our training, 
maybe... we really can go from the Aoba 
Sho to winning the Derby...!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, the reaction is great. A 
well-reasoned argument really does inspire 
more confidence!
choice_data_list:
A lot of people are saying they want to 
see you achieve greatness, too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under normal circumstances, expectations 
are placed on an Umamusume's strength. 
However, when a historic first is about to 
be achieved, it's only natural for fans to 
want to witness that very moment.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Defeating Taishin-san and the others at 
the Japan Derby would be ideal, but...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If we put up a good fight, we should 
definitely leave a stronger impression 
than them!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, this is what making drama is all 
about— the power of self-production!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The main event of the Japan Derby 
approaches. And that goes for them, too—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: One, two, three, four...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Five, six............ Uuuuugh!! So itchy, 
my back is so itchyーーー!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It itches so much~~! H-Hold on, let me 
cool it down with a towel!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Ticket-san...
choice_data_list: I wonder what's wrong with her...?
I wonder what's wrong with her...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It seems Ticket-san's body gets all itchy 
whenever she gets nervous.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps... she's feeling nervous with the 
Derby coming up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite being the race favorite in the 
Satsuki Sho, Winning Ticket finished in 
4th place.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
After all, the Derby is the stage 
Ticket-san has dreamed of for so long...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I've always, always dreamed of it. 
Becoming a Derby Umamusume and giving 
dreams to everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I hope I can run a race in the Satsuki Sho 
that will pave the way to the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If the itching is caused by stress, a diet 
that restores your "qi" might help. Let's 
ask Chitose O about it.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...To think I wouldn't hear Ticket-san 
yelling, 'DEEERRRBYYY!'"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Doesn't feel much like our Derby, does 
it?"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, today's training is... Oh, fast 
gallops, right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...Not again...! Urrrgh! It itches so 
baaaad!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... In this state, there's no way I can 
do a proper final workout...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ......It itches so bad...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"What's wrong, Ticket? We're about to 
start training, aren't we?"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide, Taishin... The thing is... my 
body is so itchy...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me you're heading home already? 
Huh, pretty relaxed, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Or... are you planning to run away?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It might not be your fault if you're not 
feeling well, but deep down inside, aren't 
you just trying to use it as an excuse?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
So your passion for the Derby only 
amounted to that much.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
N-No! The Derby is my dream! ...It's my 
dream! U-Uuuuugh!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haa... Why are you fighting? Both of you, 
go cool your heads.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Keeping your body cool will make the 
itchiness less likely to flare up. We just 
need to adjust your training routine.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wait... You'll join me? ...The Derby's 
coming up, you know?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, just for this time. I, too, don't 
want to leave any regrets for the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However—we fully intend to carry out our 
preparations as scheduled as well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I've got no intention of waiting around 
for you while you drag your feet.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Done warming up? Then let's do a 
side-by-side run—no, a swim race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
This is in place of an official final 
workout, so we're going all out. —Ready, 
start!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SPLAAAASH!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, hold on! Is a late start like this 
even legal—!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: L-Like I'd ever lose!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...Pfft, Taishin! *Gasp*, Hayahide! Wait 
upーー, *gasp*!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh, haah, haah...! Don't talk while 
you're swimming!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*! *pant*, *pant*... As always... 
your athletic reflexes are phenomenal...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Puha, DAAAAERBY! Puha, BEEEEEE!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(...Looks like there was no need for me to 
step in.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japan Derby. Tokyo 
Racecourse was, as expected, overflowing 
with bustling excitement and fiery heat.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Chitose O-san! You made it in time for 
the Derby! I'm so glad... truly."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Yes. After the video with Royce-san... I 
decided to re-evaluate... my recuperation 
routine—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
"I didn't let my slump drag on after that 
either."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"It's all because you never gave up, 
Chitose O-san, and kept searching for ways 
to work in harmony with your body!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... Who can say...? The Goddess is 
ever fickle, after all...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
...Though belated, I have come to 
fulfill... my pledge to you.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're full of spirit, aren't you? I 
won't lose either!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, another troublesome rival has joined 
the fray, hasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
She's a formidable rival who brings a 
dramatic backstory, overcoming physical 
weaknesses to race. You'd better brace 
yourself!
choice_data_list: Don't you look a little happy?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Does it look like that to you? In that 
case, I suppose you could call it a 
fearless grin, ready to take on all 
comers."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Contrary to her words, her genuine joy 
over Sakura Chitose O running shone 
through every little thing she said.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Found yooou, Royce! We came to cheer you 
on!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Kya, Turbo-san! Everyone else too! You 
came for me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The ones who showed up were Twin Turbo, 
the ever-blazing front-runner, along with 
Ikuno Dictus and the others.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, naturally. After all, Royce and the 
others came all the way to cheer me on 
too, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That gave me so much strength! I'll send 
some power your way too, Royce-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Speaking with unusual passion is none 
other than the easygoing, fluffy 
Umamusume, Matikane Tannhauser.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It is the Derby, after all. Just being 
able to run in it is amazing...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And to top it off, she's taking on the 
greatest wall in racing history!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, forgive my rudeness the other day, 
Maestro. I am an Umamusume who loves 
music, Sounds of Earth.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, forgive my rudeness the other day, 
Maestra. I am an Umamusume who loves 
music, Sounds of Earth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No, I know their names of course, and Lois 
and Lois had told me they were folks she 
hung around with a lot.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, shall what is woven be an Eroica, or 
perhaps a Capriccio!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Well, it's your big moment on stage, 
after all. Self-producing, was it? We'll 
help hype things up for you too."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly, that's why Royce has to 
win! You absoooolutely have to win!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's so reassuring!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! So this is the Derby's view! It 
really does feel different from usual!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All right! ...*Inhaaaale*...――

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: DEEERRRBYYYY!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Heheh, now I'm all fired up!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hey, Ticket. Keep it quiet in the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That's right! Everyone, I'm so sorry!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Geez, just when I thought I was getting 
back on track, this happens...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. That's what makes it... all the 
more worthwhile to crush them.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Well, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Go, Taishiiiin!" "Today's your day, 
Hayahide!" "You're gonna be the Derby 
Umamusume, Ticket!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(There's so much cheering for Hayahide-san 
and the others... Well, her performance in 
the Satsuki Sho was truly magnificent.)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: (Even so—)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Congrats on running in the Derby, 
Royce-chan!" "Royce! Show us a historic 
first!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: (There are cheers for me, too...!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(An Umamusume who missed out on the 
'Satsuki Sho,' putting everything on the 
line for the Derby......)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Now, this is the culmination of my 
self-production!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(With my touching drama, I'll engrave 
myself deep into everyone's memories!)
